Building evacuation on a grid

Occupants leaving a building laid out as a grid of rooms and corridors, routing around walls to reach an exit.

What to watch for

The dark cells are blocked and the agents path around them. Nobody told the animation where the walls are: the grid geometry comes from the model, so the picture cannot disagree with what the pathfinder believes.

Underneath

This is a real run of a real model, not a recording. The page fetched the trace (7 KB gzipped) and drew it through the same renderer the desktop animation application uses. Download it and open it there to lay it out yourself.

Read the model's source — the simulation is not modified to be animated; capture is a flag on a run.
